Trickcal.help: Trickcal login, daily sign-in, mailbox, friends, tasks, the shop free gifts, bulk purchase in the normal shop and the adventure pass

Hazeworldevent.name: Event: 艾吉斯未解之迷
Hazeworldevent.help:
Sweep a cleared stage in the limited event 「艾吉斯未解之迷」: enter the event, pick a stage marked CLEAR, press Sweep, then MAX to spend all stamina, Start Sweep and confirm the result.
The stage must be cleared already. The script presses Sweep only, never Battle Prep, and does not clear stages for you; clear it manually before enabling this task or it stalls on the stage list.
MAX spends stamina down to the last affordable run; when even one sweep is unaffordable, the script stops without pressing Start Sweep and schedules the next daily run.

HazeworldExercise.name: Exercise
HazeworldExercise.help: Spend the daily exercise tickets in the arena

HazeworldTask.name: Mission
HazeworldTask.help: Claim daily, weekly and monthly mission rewards

HazeworldPass.name: Battle pass
HazeworldPass.help: Claim battle pass missions and level rewards

HazeworldSupport.name: Support character
HazeworldSupport.help: Claim the friendship coins of support characters

HazeworldCore.name: Core material
HazeworldCore.help: Sweep core material stages in the resource dungeon, spends stamina

HazeworldShop.name: Elite shop
HazeworldShop.help: Buy from the elite shop of the mall exchange with a purchase list, weekly

HazeworldLogistics.name: Logistics shop
HazeworldLogistics.help: Buy from the logistics shop of the exchange shop, everything but 盾币 by default, once a week

HazeworldHonor.name: Honor shop
HazeworldHonor.help: Buy only the first card (定向调度券) of the honour shop in the mall, once a week

LostswordTreasure.name: Lost Sword: Treasure
LostswordTreasure.help: Claim the idle rewards and use the free quick explore

LostswordSummon.name: Lost Sword: Free summon
LostswordSummon.help: Take the daily free pull in the character and pet pools

LostswordShop.name: Lost Sword: Shop
LostswordShop.help: Claim the daily, weekly and monthly free gifts

LostswordMail.name: Lost Sword: Mailbox
LostswordMail.help: Claim the attachments in the mailbox

LostswordGuild.name: Lost Sword: Guild
LostswordGuild.help: Donate gold and spirit coins, sign in, and take both guild investments; skipped when the guild entry has no red dot

LostswordBoss.name: Lost Sword: Boss raid
LostswordBoss.help: Fight once a day, then sweep the rest of the free tries

LostswordDungeon.name: Lost Sword: Squad dungeon
LostswordDungeon.help: Spend the daily try, wait for the match and the battle to clear

LostswordCopy.name: Lost Sword: Stage sweep
LostswordCopy.help: Open one sweepable stage and use the shared panel to sweep gold / exp / stones

LostswordEvent.name: Lost Sword: Event
LostswordEvent.help: Clear new events and sweep the stages already done; 探险完成 events are skipped

LostswordStar.name: Lost Sword: Star cycle
LostswordStar.help: Challenge the three adventure areas once each

LostswordArena.name: Lost Sword: Arena
LostswordArena.help: Spend arena tickets on opponents, promotion matches first; tickets pile up and are spent once a day, then the season missions are claimed

LostswordMaze.name: Lost Sword: Maze
LostswordMaze.help: Open the maze and start the auto run; it walks until the daily limit

LostswordMain.name: Lost Sword: Main story
LostswordMain.help: Push the adventure stages on normal, then hard, then hell, until the team loses

LostswordRound.name: Lost Sword: Round table
LostswordRound.help: Raise the knight order level with gold and exp books until the resources run out

LostswordAffection.name: Lost Sword: Affection talks
LostswordAffection.help: Talk to the six configured characters until the daily tries run out

LostswordTask.name: Lost Sword: Task rewards
LostswordTask.help: Claim all daily, weekly and epic task rewards

LostswordRedeem.name: Lost Sword: Coupon codes
LostswordRedeem.help: Fetch the coupon codes from GameKee once a day and redeem the new ones in the game; used and expired codes are skipped

BrowndustSummon.name: Brown Dust: Free gacha
BrowndustSummon.help: Take the daily free pull of the costume and equipment gacha

BrowndustHunt.name: Brown Dust: Quick Hunt
BrowndustHunt.help: Spend the daily quick-hunt runs of the field, coin and slime areas, and of the sacred stone caves

BrowndustManager.name: Brown Dust: Management
BrowndustManager.help: Claim the accumulated 经营管理 rewards (一键获得)

BrowndustMail.name: Brown Dust: Mail
BrowndustMail.help: Claim every attachment in 普通邮箱 (shop mail and the log page are left alone)

BrowndustTask.name: Brown Dust: Daily Quests
BrowndustTask.help: Claim the daily and weekly quest rewards (全部获得)

BrowndustEvent.name: Brown Dust: Event
BrowndustEvent.help: Five things of the running event in one task: story → battles → world boss → missions → shop

BrowndustPass.name: Brown Dust: Pass Rewards
BrowndustPass.help: Claim the missions and rewards of every pass with a red dot (全部获得)

BrowndustRedeem.name: Brown Dust: Coupon codes
BrowndustRedeem.help: Fetch the coupon codes of the game from GameKee once a day and redeem the new ones; used and expired codes are skipped

ChaoszeroArk.name: Chaos Zero: Ark City dailies
ChaoszeroArk.help: Three things in 方舟都市: approve a few policies in 政策室 (each one costs a day), order once at 庭院咖啡廳 for 120 stamina, and buy out 諾諾商店 from the top (it never buys 單元幣 and skips any greyed-out 購買). If the cafe already served you today it is skipped, not treated as a failure

ChaoszeroSimulation.name: Chaos Zero: Battle training (spend stamina)
ChaoszeroSimulation.help: Walks 模擬 → 戰鬥訓練 and farms the ticked tabs in order: open the stage, apply difficulty and battle efficiency, fight, make sure auto-battle is on, take the result, and repeat until the stamina or the daily attempts run out

ChaoszeroDaily.name: Chaos Zero: Daily claim (missions + mailbox)
ChaoszeroDaily.help: Opens the top-right menu and does two things: (1) 日常任務 → the 全部領取 button of 當日行程; (2) the envelope in the vertical column that appears on the right edge once the menu is open → 信箱, then 全部領取 there. Both buttons are orange while something is left and grey once done. It only claims - the missions themselves are done by the 模擬 and 方舟都市 tasks

ChaoszeroPass.name: Chaos Zero: Pass (阿爾基亞農補給)
ChaoszeroPass.help: Opens 阿爾基亞農補給 from the top-right menu: claims the 每日 / 每週 / 賽季 mission rewards in the 任務 view (they apply on the spot, no popup), then switches to the 獎勵 view and claims the level rewards (those pop the generic 獲得道具 window). Both views have a 全部領取 button at the bottom: an orange round arrow means something is left, grey means done. It only claims - the missions themselves are done by the 模擬 and 方舟都市 tasks

ChaoszeroRedeem.name: Chaos Zero: Coupon codes
ChaoszeroRedeem.help: Fetch the coupon codes from GameKee once a day, skip the codes of the CN server, and redeem the new ones in the game; used and expired codes are skipped

ChaoszeroMain.name: Chaos Zero: Launch game
ChaoszeroMain.help: Bring the client from a cold start, the title screen or the idle artwork to the main page, claiming nothing. Every other task of this game starts from there

CrosscoreMain.name: Cross Core: Launch game
CrosscoreMain.help: Bring the client from a cold start, the title screen or a sub page to the main page, claiming nothing. Every other task of this game starts from there

CrosscoreRedeem.name: Cross Core: Coupon codes
CrosscoreRedeem.help: Fetch the Cross Core coupon codes from GameKee and submit the new ones one by one in 菜单 → 设置 → 补给兑换; the toast the game raises decides the result and a settled code is not sent again. Codes of both the official server and B server are tried: the one that does not belong to this account is answered with an error, which only costs one press

CrosscoreMail.name: Cross Core: Mail
CrosscoreMail.help: Collect every mail with one press. Whether anything is left is read from the golden highlight of the claim button; once it greys out the task goes back to the lobby

CrosscoreTask.name: Cross Core: Tasks
CrosscoreTask.help: Collect the daily and weekly task rewards: press 「一键领取」 on the daily tab until it greys out, then do the same on the weekly tab. Story tasks are not touched

CrosscorePass.name: Cross Core: Pass
CrosscorePass.help: Collect the pass (Exploration Guide) rewards: open 「任务」 and press 「领取奖励」 on every row of the daily, weekly and season tabs, then 「全部领取」 for the level rewards; the button disappears when nothing is left

CrosscoreExplore.name: Cross Core: Daily Explore
CrosscoreExplore.help: Enter via 「出擊 → 每日探索」 from the lobby and farm a single sub-stage as configured: pick that sub-stage's highest unlocked floor, press 「掃蕩 → 開始戰鬥」, accept the drop bonus with 「使用」, then press 「獎勵」 at the bottom right to close the result screen and return to the main screen. Sweeping consumes all stamina

CrosscoreExercise.name: Cross Core: Simulation Exercise
CrosscoreExercise.help: Enter via 「出擊 → 模擬軍演 → 鏡像競技」 from the lobby. Always fight the first opponent (power is ignored) for all 10 daily simulation attempts; victory and defeat both end on the same result page, which is dismissed with a tap on the blank area. Then open 「商店兌換」 and buy from the top-left item in order, using 「最大」 for stackable items and skipping 星幣 / 技術點 until only those two are left

CrosscoreBase.name: Cross Core: Base
CrosscoreBase.help: Collect base materials, rotate the staff on schedule, and buy construction orders from your own and your friends' libraries. Missing materials are crafted first

Starsavior2.name: Star Savior: Reroll
Starsavior2.help:
Warning: this tool is still in testing. Behaviour may change, and it may contain bugs.
Tested on: MuMu emulator 12, Asia server, in-game Simplified Chinese, lowest graphics. Other emulators / resolutions / languages / graphics settings are untested.
Stutters and dead clicks caused by the game itself (e.g. a ~15s freeze after the journey settlement) are not worked around; the script just waits them out.

TrickcalLogin.name: Trickcal Login
TrickcalLogin.help: Launch the client, walk through the title screen and login, claim the daily sign-in reward, dismiss the reward and announcement popups, and stop at the lobby. A return-event panel normally does not appear; if it does, it is only closed and no return rewards are claimed. Runs once after the daily reset.

TrickcalMail.name: Trickcal Mail
TrickcalMail.help: Open the mailbox from the envelope at the top right of the lobby, claim every attachment with the bottom-right claim-all button, dismiss the confirmation reward popup, and return to the lobby. Runs once after the daily reset.

TrickcalFriend.name: Trickcal Friends
TrickcalFriend.help: Open the friend list from the top right of the lobby. The claim-all button lights up when friends have sent leaves, and is only clicked while lit; then send one back with the send-all button and return to the lobby. Neither button opens a popup, so the run does not wait for one.

TrickcalTask.name: Trickcal Tasks
TrickcalTask.help: Open the task list from the checklist at the top right of the lobby (it opens on the daily tab), claim with the bottom-right claim-all button, then claim the bottom-left point-track reward if it is lit; switch to the weekly tab and repeat the same order, then return to the lobby. A button is only clicked while lit; grey means there is nothing to claim.

TrickcalShop.name: Trickcal Shop
TrickcalShop.help: Open the premium shop from the bottom bar of the lobby and visit the three tabs in order - 水晶葉商店 (the daily free pack), 每週禮包 and 每月禮包 - claiming the free pack in the top-left slot of each (price 0). Claiming pops the generic reward panel; the panel showing up is the receipt, and no panel means that pack was already taken this period, so it is skipped. The task then returns to the lobby.

TrickcalNormalShop.name: Trickcal Normal Shop
TrickcalNormalShop.help: Open the normal shop from the 商店 icon at the bottom of the lobby and buy only the 日常商店 tab - the other tabs spend different currencies and are never touched. Tick all six items with 全選, press 一鍵購買, confirm the purchase dialog, dismiss the reward panel and return to the lobby.

TrickcalPass.name: Trickcal Adventure Pass
TrickcalPass.help: Open the 冒險通行證 card at the top left of the lobby (the blue ticket, not the level pass next to it) and press the bottom-right 一鍵領取 to take every unlocked reward at once. The button is dim when there is nothing to claim, and the run then returns immediately. The reward panel is dismissed automatically.

Enable.name: Enable Task
Enable.help:
Join this task to scheduler.
Task commission, research, reward are force to enable.

NextRun.name: Next Run
NextRun.help:
Updated automatically after completing the task to set next scheduled run, typically not manually modified
However you can force immediate scheduling if text field cleared

SuccessInterval.name: Success Interval
SuccessInterval.help: After successful, postpone next run for X minutes

FailureInterval.name: Failure Interval
FailureInterval.help: After failure, postpone next run for X minutes

ServerUpdate.name: Server Update
ServerUpdate.help: Series of server refresh time(s) as to when this task will next run, this is automatically converted to respective time zone, generally do not need to modify

Serial.name: Serial
Serial.help:
Common emulator Serial can be queried in the list below
Use "auto" to auto-detect emulators, but if multiple emulators are running or use emulators that do not support auto-detect, "auto" cannot be used and serial must be filled in manually
Default serial for select emulators:
- BlueStacks 127.0.0.1:5555
- BlueStacks4 Hyper-V use "bluestacks4-hyperv", "bluestacks4-hyperv-2" for multi instance, and so on
- BlueStacks5 Hyper-V use "bluestacks5-hyperv", "bluestacks5-hyperv-1" for multi instance, and so on
- NoxPlayer 127.0.0.1:62001
- NoxPlayer64bit 127.0.0.1:59865
- MuMuPlayer/MuMuPlayer X 127.0.0.1:7555
- MuMuPlayer12 127.0.0.1:16384
- MemuPlayer 127.0.0.1:21503
- LDPlayer emulator-5554 or 127.0.0.1:5555
If there are multiple emulator instances running, the default is reserved for one of them and the others will use different serials to avoid conflicts
Open console.bat and run `adb devices` to find them or follow the emulator's official tutorial

PackageName.name: Game Server
PackageName.help: Game to open first. The scheduler switches games by itself afterwards; "Auto-detect" prefers the game already in the foreground, otherwise picks the first registered one

ServerName.name: Server in Game Client
ServerName.help:
Select the server where you are in the game to enable server status detection
Script will hang up when server is being maintained or network is broken

ScreenshotMethod.name: Screenshot Method
ScreenshotMethod.help:
When using auto-select, a benchmark will be performed and automatically changed to the fastest screenshot method.
General speed: nemu_ipc ~= ldopengl >> DroidCast_raw >> aScreenCap_nc > ADB_nc >>> aScreenCap > uiautomator2 ~= ADB.
nemu_ipc requires MuMu Player 12 (>=3.8.13) and ldopengl requires LDPlayer 9/14. Both are included in the benchmark automatically when the matching emulator is detected; otherwise select them manually.
aScreenCap / aScreenCap_nc only work on Android 5~9.
Run Tools - Performance Test to find the fastest method.

ControlMethod.name: Control Method
ControlMethod.help:
Speed: minitouch > Hermit > MaaTouch > uiautomator2 ~= ADB
MaaTouch is recommended by default (stable and compatible); minitouch is faster but depends on the uiautomator2 service; Hermit is only for VMOS

ScreenshotDedithering.name: Image Color De-dithering
ScreenshotDedithering.help: Enable when running Alas on phones

AdbRestart.name: Try to restart adb when no device found

_info.name: Emulator Settings
_info.help: The following values are auto-filled according to "Serial", if you don’t understand, please don't modify them

HandleError.name: Enable Exception Handling
HandleError.help: Handles select exceptions, will retreat if in battle

SaveError.name: Record Exception
SaveError.help: Records exception and log into directory for review or sharing

OnePushConfig.name: Error notify config
OnePushConfig.help:
When Alas cannot handle exception, send a message through Onepush. Configuration document: 
https://github.com/LmeSzinc/AzurLaneAutoScript/wiki/Onepush-configuration-%5BEN%5D

ScreenshotLength.name: Record Screenshot(s)
ScreenshotLength.help: Number of screenshots saved when exception occurs

ScreenshotInterval.name: Take Screenshots Every X Second(s)
ScreenshotInterval.help: Minimum interval between 2 screenshots, limited in 0.1 ~ 0.3, can help reduce CPU on high-end PCs

CombatScreenshotInterval.name: Take Screenshots Every X Second(s) In Combat
CombatScreenshotInterval.help: Minimum interval between 2 screenshots, limited in 0.3 ~ 1.0, can help reduce CPU during battle

TaskHoardingDuration.name: Hoard Tasks For X Minute(s)
TaskHoardingDuration.help:
By purposely not adding ready tasks to pending, allows for larger subsets to be built and run en masse at a later time
Can reduce the frequency of operating AL

WhenTaskQueueEmpty.name: When Task Queue is Empty
WhenTaskQueueEmpty.help: Close AL when there are no pending tasks, can help reduce CPU

ClaimDaily.name: Claim daily mission rewards
ClaimDaily.help: Switch to the "Daily" tab and press "Claim all"

ClaimWeekly.name: Claim weekly mission rewards
ClaimWeekly.help: Switch to the "Weekly" tab and press "Claim all"

ClaimMonthly.name: Claim monthly mission rewards
ClaimMonthly.help: Switch to the "Monthly" tab and press "Claim all"

ClaimTask.name: Claim battle pass missions
ClaimTask.help: Switch to the "Daily", "Weekly" and "Period" tab and press "Claim all" on each. The missions grant the points that level the pass up, and a level is what holds a reward

ClaimAll.name: Claim level rewards
ClaimAll.help: Press "Claim all" on the reward view of the battle pass to claim the rewards of every level reached

LikeAll.name: Like all friends
LikeAll.help: Press "Like all" in the friend list

ClaimAll.name: Claim all mails
ClaimAll.help: Press "Claim all" on the mail page to take every unread attachment

CollectAll.name: Collect all resources
CollectAll.help: Press "Collect all" in the command room

Expedition.name: Handle expeditions
Expedition.help: Claim finished expeditions and send the teams out again. An expedition comes back after the hours it was sent for, and the script returns then

Team1Task.name: Team 1 expedition
Team1Task.help: Which expedition this team runs. "Do not send" leaves the team idle

Team1Hours.name: Team 1 duration
Team1Hours.help: How many hours to send them for. The script comes back after the expedition returns

Team2Task.name: Team 2 expedition
Team2Task.help: Which expedition this team runs. "Do not send" leaves the team idle

Team2Hours.name: Team 2 duration
Team2Hours.help: How many hours to send them for. The script comes back after the expedition returns

ProxyBattle.name: Use proxy battle
ProxyBattle.help: Sweep every ticket of the day with "代理作战"; turn it off to fight one by one and watch the fights

ClaimAll.name: Claim friendship coins
ClaimAll.help: Open "支援角色" in the player profile and claim every support character, 50000 per day at most

Monday.name: Monday
Monday.help: Which core to farm that day. "Skip" leaves the day alone. Only the selected entry has the gold bar on its left edge

Tuesday.name: Tuesday
Tuesday.help: Which core to farm that day. "Skip" leaves the day alone. Only the selected entry has the gold bar on its left edge

Wednesday.name: Wednesday
Wednesday.help: Which core to farm that day. "Skip" leaves the day alone. Only the selected entry has the gold bar on its left edge

Thursday.name: Thursday
Thursday.help: Which core to farm that day. "Skip" leaves the day alone. Only the selected entry has the gold bar on its left edge

Friday.name: Friday
Friday.help: Which core to farm that day. "Skip" leaves the day alone. Only the selected entry has the gold bar on its left edge

Saturday.name: Saturday
Saturday.help: Which core to farm that day. "Skip" leaves the day alone. Only the selected entry has the gold bar on its left edge

Sunday.name: Sunday
Sunday.help: Which core to farm that day. "Skip" leaves the day alone. Only the selected entry has the gold bar on its left edge

SweepCount.name: Sweep count
SweepCount.help:
0 presses "MAX" and spends every bit of stamina, a positive number sweeps exactly that many runs. A count the stamina cannot pay for is reduced to what it pays for, and a run without a single run worth of stamina is skipped.
The stage is whatever the game has selected, pick it in game first, the script does not change it

Filter.name: Shop filter
Filter.help:
All: buy everything the list does not exclude with !; Custom: follow the purchase list below; None: buy nothing.
The ! lines hold in every mode, so 盾币 and 精英演习券 are never bought whichever mode is selected.

Purchases.name: Purchase list
Purchases.help:
One rule per line, matched as a substring of the item name; inside a line > separates alternatives and any hit buys; a line starting with ! excludes; # starts a comment.
The default buys 残响, 调度券, 自选水晶, 核心, 绝密报告 and 能量合剂, and never 盾币 or 精英演习券. Leave it blank to buy nothing.
The order is the shop order, left to right and top to bottom within a column, one of each item per run; sold-out cards and cards the gold cannot cover are skipped.

Filter.name: Shop filter
Filter.help:
All: buy everything the list does not exclude with !; Custom: follow the purchase list below; None: buy nothing.
The ! lines hold in every mode, so 盾币 is never bought whichever mode is selected.

Purchases.name: Purchase list
Purchases.help:
One rule per line, matched as a substring of the item name; inside a line > separates alternatives and any hit buys; a line starting with ! excludes; # starts a comment.
The default is All: buy whatever is on the shelf, 盾币 alone excepted (it is a 1 point conversion ticket with unlimited stock).
The order is left to right, top card before bottom card, one of each per run; sold out or unaffordable cards are skipped.

Filter.name: Shop filter
Filter.help:
All: buy everything the list does not exclude with !; Custom: check the first card against the list below; None: buy nothing.
This task only ever buys the first card of the shelf, so this is really an on/off switch.

Purchases.name: Purchase list
Purchases.help:
Used to check that the first card really is the wanted item: when the name does not match, nothing is bought, so a week in which the game puts something else first is left alone.
One rule per line, matched as a substring of the item name; inside a line > separates alternatives; a line starting with ! excludes; # starts a comment.
The default is 定向调度券. It buys until the card is sold out or the balance runs out; how many are on offer is up to the game.

Claim.name: Claim treasure
Claim.help: Claim the treasure accumulated while idle

Quick.name: Daily free quick explore
Quick.help: Use the free quick explore of the day; skip it when diamonds are required

Sweep.name: Sweep the rest
Sweep.help: When off only the battle is fought, the other free tries are left alone

Name1.name: Character 1
Name1.help: The name written under the card on the character page

Name2.name: Character 2
Name2.help: The name written under the card on the character page

Name3.name: Character 3
Name3.help: The name written under the card on the character page

Name4.name: Character 4
Name4.help: The name written under the card on the character page

Name5.name: Character 5
Name5.help: The name written under the card on the character page

Name6.name: Character 6
Name6.help: The name written under the card on the character page

Claim.name: Claim once per game session
Claim.help: When off nothing is claimed, but the task keeps its own schedule

Draw.name: Draw both free pools
Draw.help: When off nothing is drawn, but the task keeps its own schedule

Draw.name: Take both free pulls
Draw.help: When off, nothing is pulled, the task is still scheduled

_info.name: Event
_info.help: The five things the running event offers, in one task and in this order: story → battles → world boss → missions → shop. The story spends nothing, the battles spend event AP and earn the currency, the boss climbs from the easiest difficulty, the missions are claimed after the steps that finish them, and the shop spends the currency last. One trip into the event page; a step that fails is skipped without taking the others down.

BattleMode.name: Which mode
BattleMode.help: Normal = normal battles only (first clears pay gacha currency, keep it on early); Challenge = challenge only; Both = play both, split by the fights below.

Times.name: Fights per mode
Times.help: Normal and challenge battles share the same 5 daily AP. With Both, each mode gets this many; with a single mode it gets all 5.

ShopFilter.name: Purchase priority
ShopFilter.help: Separated by >, leftmost is bought first, anything not listed is never bought. Codes: Paid (diamond-priced goods), EquipUR / EquipSR (event equipment), EquipMaterial (equipment upgrade material), GachaTicket, GoddessTear, AncientCrystal, Essence, RefineCrystal, Star4 (4-star star-up). Anything else is matched against the item name, so writing the name in your own language works too.

BuyAmount.name: How many per entry
BuyAmount.help: max = buy the whole limit of that entry (the game refuses when coins run out); one = buy a single one.

_info.name: Quick Hunt Settings
_info.help: The two groups have separate daily caps, see each entry

HuntField.name: Hunting Field runs
HuntField.help: Runs per day in 狩猎场, 0 = skip. The field, coin and slime areas share one stamina bar, so the three together cannot exceed 15

HuntCoin.name: Coin Area runs
HuntCoin.help: Runs per day in the coin area, 0 = skip. Shares stamina with the field and slime areas, 15 in total

HuntSlime.name: Slime Area runs
HuntSlime.help: Runs per day in the slime area, 0 = skip. Shares stamina with the field and coin areas, 15 in total

CaveFire.name: Fire Cave runs
CaveFire.help: Sacred stone cave, fire. 0 = skip. The five caves share the torch, 10 in total

CaveWater.name: Water Cave runs
CaveWater.help: Sacred stone cave, water. 0 = skip. The five caves share the torch, 10 in total

CaveWind.name: Wind Cave runs
CaveWind.help: Sacred stone cave, wind. 0 = skip. The five caves share the torch, 10 in total

CaveLight.name: Light Cave runs
CaveLight.help: Sacred stone cave, light. 0 = skip. The five caves share the torch, 10 in total

CaveDark.name: Dark Cave runs
CaveDark.help: Sacred stone cave, dark. 0 = skip. The five caves share the torch, 10 in total

_info.name: Battle training
_info.help: One switch per tab, plus which row, difficulty, efficiency and rounds

TrainingGrowth.name: Growth
TrainingGrowth.help: Farm the 成長 tab (unit coins and upgrade materials)

TrainingMember.name: Fighters
TrainingMember.help: Farm the 戰鬥員 tab (ascension materials)

TrainingPartner.name: Partners
TrainingPartner.help: Farm the 夥伴 tab (ascension materials)

TrainingPotential.name: Potential
TrainingPotential.help: Farm the 潛力 tab (fire / order / instinct / void)

TrainingMemory.name: Memory shards
TrainingMemory.help: Farm the 記憶碎片 tab, 60 stamina per run

TrainingChallenge.name: Challenge
TrainingChallenge.help: Farm the 挑戰 tab, 3 attempts a day, no stamina

TrainingStage.name: Row
TrainingStage.help: Counted from the top of the list, four rows per screen: 1-4, then 5, 6… as you scroll. One number for all tabs (記憶碎片 has 11 rows, 戰鬥員/夥伴 6, 潛力 5, 成長 3, 挑戰 2); a tab with fewer rows is skipped

TrainingDifficulty.name: Difficulty
TrainingDifficulty.help: 1-6. 0 leaves whatever the game has selected

TrainingEfficiency.name: Battle efficiency
TrainingEfficiency.help: 1-6 runs per entry; cost = stamina per run x efficiency. This is an upper bound: it is lowered to what the current stamina can pay for each round, so stamina never sits at full. 0 leaves the game's setting

TrainingTimes.name: Rounds per tab
TrainingTimes.help: 0 = keep going until the stamina runs out

_info.name: Ark City
_info.help: How many policies to approve, which side, whether to order at the cafe, and whether to buy from the shop

PolicyEnable.name: Policy room
PolicyEnable.help: Whether to approve policies at all

PolicyTimes.name: How many
PolicyTimes.help: 0 = approve every proposal the deck offers, N = at most N. Each approval spends one day (the 倒數 counter drops), so approving everything burns the season fast

PolicySide.name: Which proposal
PolicySide.help: auto = pick by reward: the one with more extra rewards wins, and 政策點數 does not count (tie goes to the left). left / right = always that one

CafeOrder.name: Order at the cafe
CafeOrder.help: Once a day: 內用 restores 120 stamina right away. After that the menu stops opening and the task ends normally

ShopPurchase.name: 諾諾商店
ShopPurchase.help: Buys the shelf out from the top, pressing MAX on each product. 單元幣 is never bought; products whose 購買 button is grey (holding cap reached, not enough coins) are skipped

_info.name: Daily Explore Settings
_info.help: Only one sub-stage is farmed per run so stamina is not spread thin; the highest unlocked floor of that sub-stage is picked automatically

Explore.name: Explore Stage
Explore.help: The explore sub-stage to sweep. The script picks its highest unlocked floor and sweeps until stamina runs out

_info.name: Base Settings
_info.help: The script never mixes teams: the first readable preset decides, and every facility is aligned to the other team

Team1Hours.name: Team 1 Hours
Team1Hours.help: How long team 1 works. Every run of Base switches to the other team; when a run leaves team 1 on duty, the next run is scheduled from this value

Team2Hours.name: Team 2 Hours
Team2Hours.help: How long team 2 works. Every run of Base switches to the other team; when a run leaves team 2 on duty, the next run is scheduled from this value

_info.name: Reroll settings
_info.help:
Set the package name and resolution in "Settings -> Emulator" first, then press Start here. Only one of the three modes takes effect:
1) Target character(s) set (up to 7): reroll round after round. "Win condition" decides what counts: "any one character" stops once a single listed character reaches its own count, "all" needs every selected target. On a hit the account is kept (no reset); on a miss the account is reset and the next round starts.
2) Stop-at set: stop right after that checkpoint.
3) Target character and Stop-at both empty: run exactly one round, stop after the roster check, no reset.

Nickname.name: Nickname
Nickname.help: Leave empty for a random 10-character mix of letters and digits each round (no words — the game rejects names containing "unusable characters"). ASCII letters and digits only (the game input box cannot take Chinese), 4-16 characters; other characters are stripped, and a result shorter than 4 falls back to a random name.

TargetMode.name: Win condition
TargetMode.help:
How the targets are counted as a hit.
- Any one character: a single listed character reaching its own count is a hit (default, fastest).
- All: every selected target must reach its own count, otherwise reset and reroll. E.g. 4 copies of A plus 1 of B needs both.
TargetMode.any: Any one character reaches its count

Target.name: Target character
Target.help: Up to 7 targets can be set (this is #1; "Target 2" to "Target 7" follow). See "Win condition" above; each target has its own count. All seven set to "Not set" runs a single round only. Warning: mutually exclusive with "Stop at".
Target.none: Not set (one round, stop after the roster check)

StopAt.name: Stop at
StopAt.help:
For step-by-step runs and debugging: stop right after this checkpoint, without resetting.
Not set = no checkpoint, normal rerolling: with a target character it keeps repeating until the target drops, without one it runs a single round.
Warning: when a checkpoint is set, "Target character" is ignored.
StopAt.none: Not set (no checkpoint; repeat while a target is set)
StopAt.guide: Checkpoint 2: guides finished (no reward, no gacha)
StopAt.verify: Checkpoint 3: all the way to the roster check

RerollCount.name: Reroll count
RerollCount.help:
Stop after this many rounds, **without resetting** — the account stays as it is.
0 = unlimited (default): with targets set it keeps rerolling until they drop.
One round = login -> nickname -> guide -> journey -> result -> rewards -> gacha -> roster check; hitting the targets stops it earlier, no extra round.
WARNING: with "Stop at" set too, whichever comes first wins.

Round.name: Current round (read-only)
Round.help: Which round this run is on since it started. Resets to 0 every time you press Start; written by the script itself, so you do not have to dig through the log for "round N".

Storage.help: Internal state written while the task runs; do not edit it by hand, clear it if the task misbehaves
